title: RIPDPI client network hint
description: Version 1 response body of GET field_report.network_hint_endpoint. The subscription host looks up the request source address in a pinned offline IP-to-ASN dataset and returns only the ASN and its registration country. The address itself is not returned, logged or stored. The host answers 204 with no body when the address has no routed ASN. The client fetches the hint directly, outside the tunnel, discards a hint fetched through the tunnel, and uses it as network.source server_hint in contract/client-field-report.schema.json until observed_at plus ttl_seconds has passed.
$comment: Canonical source: ripdpi-vpn-deploy/contract/client-network-hint.schema.json. Keep the client vendored copy byte-identical. x-contract-version is the cross-repo drift pin.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 registration country of the ASN, in upper case.

observed_at.description: Lookup time in UTC, rounded down to the hour.
